events.text_en: When the grey rises over Chiết Kích Nguyên, the levy captain Thạch Liệt Hàng's file of forty holds its line, breathes through one wet cloth in turns and walks out backwards; thirty-one come home.
Nhạn Trận Môn drills the farmers of Thảo Đường and Nhạn Thanh on the shore of Lạc Nhạn Hồ for the first time; the spring levy is held there every year after.
Thạch Liệt Hàng, founder of Nhạn Trận Môn, dies of the miasma he breathed in 803, and is buried in the first burial row, beside the gaps left for those who did not come home.
Quản Tề Phong goes into seclusion to break through to Nguyên Anh and does not come out; Mục Hàn Nhạn takes the Banner of the First File.
